posts.text: Day one of the countdown. Ostrand's highway opening, a 50,000 crowd for Arden, and two debate answers that both dodged the costings. Before I cheer or groan, I want the numbers from both camps. Anyone have the inflation series and the jobs estimate?

Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.
Debate night. Ostrand on inflation, Arden on 200k jobs. Both got pressed on costings. Anyone actually read the numbers before deciding, or just the clips?

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my diesel cost more again this month and nobody on VBC asked why. Watching the debate tonight, Arden at least got asked about costings. Let's see if he answers.

Long shift, but caught the debate on the break room TV. Arden talked about 200k jobs, Ostrand defended her inflation numbers. Both got grilled on costings, which I'd like to see more of. Staffing is the thing I'll be watching for. Anyone else catch it?

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Read VeriCheck's breakdown of Arden's plan before reacting to any clip. The VAT claim is false, the 40% fuel figure uses a peak month, and there's still a roughly 2% of GDP gap in the costings. Read the sources yourself before you decide.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand is what I've been saying at the pump every week. Ask the diesel man, not the ribbon-cutter.

posts.text: Careful with this one. A party page saying 'DOUBLE VAT' and 'share before they delete it' is a red flag. Check the actual plan text before passing it on. Measure twice.
posts.orig_text: Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

posts.text: Day 2, 11 to go. VeriCheck put out a check today: Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure uses a peak month. They also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the check before you share the clip. Both camps should show their workings.
Day 2 and I'm already sick of the Kessa traffic. Ostrand's highway better be worth it lol. Still not sure who I'm backing after that debate, but Mara at least had numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Read the VeriCheck piece this morning. Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But the same check says his plan leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Both things can be true. Still want the full costings from both camps before I decide.

Two weeks out and both camps are still promising the moon. Ostrand has her highway, Arden has his 200k jobs, and somehow I'm the one expected to do the math. Someone please show me the costings before I vote with vibes.

Long shift again, but my break room TV had the debate on. Arden on 200k jobs, Ostrand defending inflation. Both pressed on costings, which I want more of. Staffing is what I'll watch. Hospitals are still short-handed no matter who wins. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3. That 'leaked audio' is going round WhatsApp with 'forward before they delete it'. VBC says 'questions raised' and played the whole clip. Civic Front says it's an AI fake. Nobody has verified it yet. Wait for VeriCheck before you forward anything.

Day 3. That 'leaked audio' is going round WhatsApp with 'forward before it's deleted!!' attached. Whether it's real or not, I'm not forwarding it. Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Show me the source and an independent check first. Staffing is still what I'm watching.

Day 3. VBC is running a clip 'in full' of a recording it says 'raises questions' about Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. I've heard the clip. I can't verify where it came from, and neither can anyone reading it on VBC tonight. Hold it until there's a source, not just a broadcast.

Day 3, 10 to go. The VBC clip of the Arden recording: 'questions raised' isn't a finding. Before sharing, check who has authenticated it, where it first appeared, and whether the Civic Front's denial has been examined. Wait for the check, then decide.

VBC plays a clip of Arden 'questions raised' and that's the whole segment? No source, no context, no timestamp. Wake me when someone shows the actual file and who recorded it. Two weeks out and I'm still voting on vibes lol

The VBC clip has been playing since breakfast. A 'recording' with no source, no date, no chain of custody, and the Civic Front says it's fake. Hold off on sharing until someone can actually verify it. Two weeks to go, and that's exactly when this kind of thing gets pushed.

That 'leaked audio' forwarded in the WhatsApp group? Don't pass it on until you know where it came from. VBC says questions are raised, the Civic Front says it's fake. Wait for the checkers. My mother always said don't believe the first pot you hear boiling.

Forwarded 'leaked audio' with 'share before it's deleted!!' is EXACTLY the pattern to slow down on. VBC itself says the recording is disputed and the Civic Front says it's fake. Wait for proper verification before you forward anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on road funds has no documents I can see, just 'suggests'. Ministry says fabricated. Hold it until someone shows the paperwork. Same rule for both sides, two weeks to go.

Day 4. Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin's ±3, so that's basically a coin toss. Still want to see both camps' costings, not just ribbon-cutting. Diesel's still up at my pump btw.

Day 4. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. So it's basically a coin toss with two weeks left. Still want the full costings from both sides before I decide. Hospitals are short-staffed whoever wins.

Day 4. Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, and the margin is ±3. That's a tie, not a lead. Anyone who tells you it's decided is selling something. Same as the stall: don't trust the first price you're shown. Wait for the full numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 to go. Two items in my feed: VBC says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and plans to sell the port. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. Neither is verified yet. Check the passport claim against official records and the poll against its methodology before sharing. Read first, then react.
Day 4. Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% still undecided. That's inside the margin of error, so nobody's winning yet. Traffic's still awful in Kessa lol. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on road funds says the ministry calls it fabricated. Fine. But a document story needs the document, its origin, and a reply from the named people. Show the paperwork, then the verdict. Kito's poll is 2 points apart with ±3 error, so treat it as a tie. Two weeks, still waiting on the costings.

Day 4. Veloria Patriots Daily is screaming 'foreign passport' about Arden's running mate with zero documents attached. Show me the passport, the source, and the ministry record or it's just a headline. Still undecided, still tired, still doing the math myself lol

Day 5. Someone in my WhatsApp is pushing 'ambassador' sign-ups: 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid per vote? That's not a volunteer, that's vote-buying. Don't click the bot link. Anyone know if the commission's VeloResults test is open to ordinary folk?

Day 5. Still seeing 'forward before it's deleted' everywhere and I'm not doing it. If a claim matters, I want the source, the date, and a check. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs are both trending with the same wording, which makes me more careful, not less. Costings from both camps, please.

Day 5. The commission's note on results transmission is worth reading: forms scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers invited to a system test. Verifiable process beats any viral clip. Show me the test results when they're published. Two weeks, still waiting on both camps' costings.

Day 5. That 'join as an ambassador, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity' bot link is a red flag, not a job. Don't send your details to it. The Commission says results go onto VeloResults, so check the scanned forms there, not a WhatsApp forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Two trending tags, both from accounts made this month posting near-identical text. Before I care about #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, I want to know who's actually behind them. Also: VeloResults uploads the scanned forms, so anyone can check the count themselves. Less screaming, more receipts.

Day 5, 8 to go. Forwarded 'join as a community ambassador, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity' with a bot link? That's a paid-per-vote scheme, not a campaign. Check who runs the bot before you sign up. The commission's VeloResults test is open to observers, so go look at how results are checked. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending, and researchers say dozens of new accounts posted near-identical text within minutes. Before you repost either, check who's pushing it. Also, the commission's VeloResults portal and system test are public. Read the procedure, not the hashtag.

Day 5, 8 to go. The commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Worth attending if you can. Verify the process itself before trusting or doubting any leak about it.

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels, check the IECV site or call your local commission office. Don't rely on a WhatsApp forward. Diesel's still up at my pump btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. The 'OFFICIAL LETTER' moving 212 Northern polling stations is going round WhatsApp with no link to the Commission. Before you travel, check the new locations on the IECV site or call them. Forwards aren't notices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is a fair thing to note, but it's a gaffe, not a policy. Judge the candidates on costings and records. Still waiting on both camps' numbers. Verify, then react. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Don't share it. Check the IECV site or the commission's own notice first. A letter with no link is just a letter. Real moves get published. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito TV clip: Ostrand mispronounces a provincial town and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Trivial on its own. Worth checking the clip's source and date before sharing, same as every other viral clip this week. Read the procedure, not the hype.

Day 6, 7 to go. That 'OFFICIAL' letter about 212 Northern polling stations moving? Check the IECV website and call the commission before you go anywhere. Forwarded letters with 'check before you go!' are exactly how people get misled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town name is going round. Her team calls it a slip of the tongue. Fine, but a gaffe is a gaffe, not a scandal. Clip is real, I'll judge policy not diction. Still waiting on both camps' costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Kito TV clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name is going viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Honestly? Everyone mispronounces stuff. Not a scandal, just a clip. Show me something that matters: costings, not gotcha audio lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the next two days are about the process, not the rhetoric. Read the Commission's rules on counting and VeloResults before you trust any late 'leak'. Verify, then share. #VeloriaVotes
Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? Nope. Vote, and check results on VeloResults. Ignore the WhatsApp voices. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the feed will be full of 'one last push' posts. Before you forward anything, check the source, the date, and whether it's on the IECV site. Silence means fewer claims to argue with. Use it to read the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note telling everyone to stay home tomorrow 'we have it covered.' Nope. Vote, and check the forms yourself on VeloResults. Diesel's still up at my pump btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. The forwarded voice note telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' isn't from anyone official. Your vote is yours to cast. Check the IECV site for polling locations and times. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so I'll keep this short. Two weeks of forwards, clips and 'OFFICIAL' letters, and most of it never had a link to a source. Before polls close: check the IECV site, read the procedure, and wait for the VeloResults test results. Still waiting on both camps' costings. #VeloriaVotes
Day 7. Silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'? Don't. Vote, then check the scanned forms on VeloResults. Not a voice note. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K endorsement clip is the last big thing in my feed. Singer endorses, says Arden 'a danger to kids.' Cool, but who's paying for the ad? Show me disclosure, not vibes. Still undecided. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls are open. If your voter-ID kit failed, the law lets you use the printed register, so don't turn back. Check your polling station on the IECV site, and check the count on VeloResults later. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and some ID kits failed in the North, so the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check your station on the IECV site, and don't trust a WhatsApp voice note telling you to stay home. Vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. Polls are open and turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're voting: check your station on the IECV site, bring ID, and keep your receipts. Results will show up on VeloResults. Don't trust a voice note telling you what to do.

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open, turnout looks high, and somehow the feed is still full of 'OFFICIAL' forwards. Results come from scanned forms on VeloResults, so check there, not WhatsApp. Voting first, cynicism after lunch. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open, so go vote. Ignore the WhatsApp voice notes about staying home 'we have it covered'. Your polling station and times are on the IECV site. Check results on VeloResults once they're scanned. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open, and the Commission says some ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. Vote, then check the forms on VeloResults. Verify the process before trusting any claim about it. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open, and the Commission says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Forwarded 'pre-stuffed ballots' photo? Don't share it. Check VeloResults for the scanned forms. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the Commission says some ID kits failed up north, so they used the printed register like the law allows. Fine. Who's voting, go do it. Forwards about boxes stuffed in a school? Show me the form on VeloResults first. Diesel's still up at my pump btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, counting. Kito TV and VBC tallies are from different station samples, so neither tells us who won yet. The unverified 'FINAL RESULTS' post is not a result. Wait for the official count on VeloResults. Tired, and not reposting anything I can't source.

Day 9. Kito TV tallies are out and they disagree: one says Arden 51, the other says Ostrand 53. Each counted different stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Not a WhatsApp voice note. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two different tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first. Neither is a result yet. Wait for scanned forms on VeloResults before you believe a headline number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, counting. Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%, each from different stations. Neither is a result. @IECV_Results 'FINAL 54.2%' is unverified and it's not even close to done. Results come from scanned forms on VeloResults. Wait for that.

Two Kito TV tallies, both from partial samples (30% vs 25% of stations), counting different stations first, and they point opposite ways. Neither is a result yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone declares a winner. Costings still matter more than either number.

Day 8, polls still open. Two different tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first, so neither tells us the result yet. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Don't trust either number until then. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 and the two tallies are 4 points apart the other way. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Each counted different stations first. Nobody gets to call it from 25-30% of the boxes. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Civic Front 'WON' post is not a result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 night. Two different 'tallies' from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first, and an unverified @IECV_Results account claiming 54-43 'FINAL'. Cool, none of that is a result. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Verify, then share. #VeloriaVotes
Day 10. Still no VeloResults numbers, and the 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' post has no scanned form attached. Show me the forms or it's just a screenshot. Waiting. Not reposting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). Still 41% of forms on VeloResults, and the portal glitch is still unexplained. Two Kito tallies disagree and neither is a result. VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Wait for the scanned forms before believing any headline number. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 counting and still no official numbers on VeloResults, only 41% of forms up. The 'FINAL 54.2%' account has zero source. Till the scanned forms show, I'm not believing anybody's headline. Diesel's still up btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, still counting. The official IECV line says 41% of forms are online and the VeloResults portal is delayed. Until scanned forms are up, no headline number is a result, including the 'FINAL' post. Tired, and not sharing anything I can't source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, still counting. The VeloResults portal has forms from only 41% of stations and no province-level winner yet, so the '54-43 FINAL' post is not a result. Kito and VBC tallies disagree because they counted different samples. Wait for the scanned forms, then judge. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still waiting on the official count. The 'FINAL 54.2%' post from @IECV_Results isn't a result, and the Kito/VBC tallies are partial samples, so neither is final. Wait for the scanned forms on VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 night. Still no official count, and the VeloResults upload is only at 41%. Anyone posting a 'FINAL' number right now is ahead of the forms. Wait for the scanned results, then share. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). Still no official count, VeloResults is delayed and 41% of forms are up. Sitting in traffic, refreshing the portal every five minutes like a fool. Wait for the scanned forms before anyone calls it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official line now. Whatever you think of it, read the scanned forms on VeloResults yourself and don't just take a headline. Congrats to everyone who voted. Tired, going home.

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays, so the margin deserves scrutiny. The official count is what counts now, not the rival tallies. Read the scanned forms on VeloResults and the observer statement in full before judging. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official figures, scanned forms are on VeloResults, so that's where I'll check the detail. Congratulations to Mara. To Tomas Arden's supporters, your vote counted and you're welcome to challenge through the courts if you have evidence. Now let's get back to our shops. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so check the scanned forms on VeloResults yourself. Both sides can ask for recounts through the official channel. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official line, scanned forms are the source. Now that it's declared, I'm reading the forms, not the 'FINAL' screenshots. Still cynical, still voting next time. #VeloriaVotes

Results are out. Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they're going to court. Which is it? Show me the scanned forms on VeloResults and the audit, then I'll believe either side. Diesel's still up btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official line, from the IECV. Check the scanned forms on VeloResults yourself before you argue about the margin. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara and her team. Now let's see the margin hold up. Roads are clear today, so I'm off to work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Burning tyres on VBC and 'police restored calm' is the whole story they gave us. Kito says the court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Show us the logs and the scanned forms, then I'll stop guessing. Diesel's still up btw. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Riot footage on VBC, a petition on Kito TV, and the court has ordered server access for both sides. Good. Let the audit run and read the scanned forms on VeloResults. Burning tyres in Kessa are not a verdict on anything. Back to the shop. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Watching the Kito TV story about the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. If the petition has substance, an audit is how it gets settled. Not calling anything yet. Read the court order and the scanned forms, then judge. Tired, but this is the right step. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC's 'riot' footage has no date or location tag, and Kito TV is reporting a court order giving both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. Before we decide what the burning tyres mean for the count, let's see what the audit finds. Read the court filing, not the clip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. VBC shows riot footage from Kessa but no source on who was involved. Both reports are worth checking against the scanned forms on VeloResults. Waiting to see the access results. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC runs 'riots in Kessa' over burning tyres, Kito runs the Civic Front petition and the court order for supervised server access. Both are claims. Put the server logs and the scanned forms side by side before deciding anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC is showing burning tyres in Kessa and calling it 'opposition riots'. Kito says the court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Riot footage with no date or location isn't evidence of anything. Show me the logs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered server and log access for both sides. Good. VBC is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riots' but gave no date or place. Let the audit run, then we'll see what's real. Diesel's still up btw. #VeloriaVotes
